summary_en: Ursa 4 K.K. (ultimately owned by Warburg Pincus fund vehicles) announced tender offer for all common shares and warrants of J.S.B. Co. (TSE Prime, code 3480), excluding treasury. Purpose: to acquire 100% ownership and delist the company (complete subsidiary). Tender price not disclosed in provided pages. Founder Okayasu Iko (33.83% stake) and OM Investment (5.37%) have executed support agreements to tender. Offer includes warrants.
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for All Shares and Warrants of J.S.B. Co., Ltd. (TSE Code: 3480) by Ursa 4 K.K.
translation_en_brief:
Ursa 4 K.K., established 25 May 2026 as the acquisition vehicle of Warburg Pincus fund entities (ultimate owner: Uvite Investments L.P., a Cayman Islands limited partnership), announced on 12 June 2026 the commencement of a tender offer under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act to acquire all common shares and warrants of J.S.B. Co. (TSE Prime, code 3480), excluding treasury shares held by the company. The stated purpose is to become the sole shareholder and achieve complete subsidiary status (非公開化), thereby delisting J.S.B. from the TSE Prime market.

Key elements: Founder and former chairman Okayasu Iko, who holds 7,187,800 shares (33.83% of outstanding, excluding treasury), and her asset management company OM Investment (holding 1,140,000 shares, 5.37%), both executed share purchase agreements on 12 June 2026 committing to tender. Mitsutsushin K.K. (267,900 shares, 1.26%) and related entities (KKLPS holding 1,219,700 shares, 5.74%) are also described as support parties. The specific tender price, offer period (start and end dates), minimum/maximum acceptance thresholds, and board recommendation status are not provided in the first two pages of the disclosure.
